chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 577: The Plan to Trap The Dice with a Xinsu
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns Xuanpin’s insane plan: to use his Xinsu power to accept all of The Dice’s lies as reality. The final gambit begins.
og_title: The Dice vs. The Reality Engine: The Plan Revealed
og_description: Great Liang's Dragon Vein is hostage. Xuanpin wants Li Huowang to weaponize his own nature. The madness intensifies.
twitter_title: The Dice vs. Li Huowang's Xinsu
twitter_description: The war council meets. The only plan is to make Li Huowang's belief a weapon. The countdown to the final confrontation begins.

lore_anchors.definition: A secret society in the Dao-Twisted World that cultivates deception; their name, meaning “The Way of Sitting in Forgetfulness,” perverts a Daoist meditative concept into a philosophy of lies.
The spiritual and metaphysical lifeblood of an imperial dynasty; a stolen Dragon Vein threatens the very existence of a realm.
A rare human constitution in the novel’s cosmology that can shape reality through belief; a living ontological hazard.
Cultivators bound to the imperial state, often under a strict chain of command via a “troop deployment tally.”
